conviction_note: The Q3 release is all but certain to land after the 26 Oct close (Sogefi's last three periodic releases went out at 18:48, 20:20 and 19:05 Milan time), so the reaction falls on 27 Oct. I scaled from the European base for new numbers with a guidance change possible (8%, which the name's own 8-16% results-day moves support) at p_up 52: the FY guide looks conservative on the company's own arithmetic, but this name sold a beat by 15.5% in July and OPmobility's 7 Oct warning hangs over the sector. Findings sum +0.7 against a scaled +0.32. The gap is the beats-sold history pulling p_up toward 50, and the two measurements are not fitted to each other.

findings.finding: The FY2026 guide (adj. EBIT margin substantially in line with 2025's 6.0%) after an H1 adj. EBIT margin of 7.5% (Q2 8.1%) implies an H2 margin of about 4.5%, below H2 2025's ~5% and well below Q3 2025's 6.7% EBIT margin. A Q3 anywhere near last year's level leaves the guide conservative and opens a firming in the 9M release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026: profitability 2-3% above Kepler with the margin guide merely confirmed, and the stock fell 15.5% on 28 Jul. FY2025: guide well below consensus and a sharp fall on 2 Mar 2026 (Intesa). Q1 2026 confirmation: up about 8% on 27 Apr (baseline history, estimated date). This name has sold a beat with an unchanged guide.
findings.original_quote: Sogefi ... prevede per il 2026 un calo dei ricavi low-single digit e conferma un margine EBIT adjusted sostanzialmente in linea con quello registrato nell'esercizio 2025 (the company expects a low-single-digit revenue decline for 2026 and confirms an adjusted EBIT margin substantially in line with FY2025; the English filing reads 'confirms an Adjusted EBIT margin substantially in line with that recorded in the 2025 financial year')
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell 15.5% on a beat and trades at 1.916, only 6% above the post-H1 1.80 and down 6.3% in 20 days. If the market read the guide as conservative, the July sell-off would have reversed and the brokers would not sit at hold. Three analysts, $0.74m a day, and no disclosed short: nobody is positioned for a firming.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 standalone EBIT 6.7% on EUR 236.4m (https://www.emarketstorage.it/sites/default/files/comunicati/2025-10/20251027_173551.pdf) gives the seasonal base. Kepler called the July drop an 'eccesso di vendite' (https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/sogefi-crolla-15-5-dopo-i-conti-ma-per-kepler-e-ipervenduto-202607281539317056).

findings.finding: OPmobility's Q3 2026 revenue rose 8.6% LFL in Europe (21 Oct), driven by Eastern European module and exterior output. Read across to Sogefi, where Europe is 56% of revenue and grew 7.1% cc in Q2 on Air & Cooling.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue has rarely been the line here. Q2 Europe outperformance of 6.7 points did not stop the -15.5% in July.
findings.why_not_priced: A peer's regional revenue is a proxy nobody maps onto a 3-analyst Italian small cap. SGF fell over the same 20 days in which OPmobility's Q3 showed Europe strong, which is not what a priced read-across would look like. The finding is still a proxy and is sized small.
findings.independence: Sogefi's own Q2 Europe +7.1% cc (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260805_187878.pdf) is the same direction from the company's own document.

findings.finding: OPmobility cut its 2026 targets on 7 Oct and announced 770 European job cuts, citing 'a deterioration in the automotive market more pronounced than anticipated', lower global production forecasts and customer activity adjustments in Europe (shares -19%). This is a negative sector read for Sogefi's H2 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sogefi's own caveat ('non si può escludere una temporanea flessione dei margini operativi') already sits in its July outlook. The stock fell 15.5% when it first appeared.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: SGF is -6.3% over 20 days and -3.5% over 5, overlapping the warning. Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until Sogefi says it, so the finding is sized small. A fully priced read would put SGF back near its July low of 1.80.
findings.independence: Reuters via syndication, 21 Oct (https://whtc.com/?p=986707): targets lowered on lower global auto production forecasts and customer adjustments in Europe.

findings.finding: The United Springs (precision springs) sale closed on 31 Jul for EUR 23.5m of cash against H1 net debt of EUR 51.2m (EUR 8.3m pre-IFRS16). Q3 should therefore show pre-IFRS16 net cash for the first time, subject to a working-capital price adjustment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No dividend was paid for 2025, and the market punished that on 2 Mar 2026. Balance-sheet strength has not been a line the stock traded on.
findings.original_quote: il corrispettivo cash incassato da Sogefi, inclusivo della stima della disponibilità di cassa al closing, è stato di Euro 23,5 milioni (the cash consideration received by Sogefi, including the estimated cash at closing, was EUR 23.5 million)
findings.why_not_priced: Public arithmetic, so mostly priced. The 'net cash' headline and any word on reinvestment or shareholder return is new, but small. The money funds 'investimenti ... di razionalizzazione' and core-market expansion, not distress.
findings.independence: The H1 report states proceeds 'will enable Sogefi to further strengthen its financial position' (https://www.emarketstorage.com/sites/default/files/comunicati/2026-08/20260805_187878.pdf).
